content.value_statement: WeChat Pay and Official Account OAuth on CloudBase require correct generated functions, openid types, and callback checks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through scenario setup, client calls, and safe extension patterns.
actual_capabilities: Routes Mini Program Pay, Official Account JSAPI Pay, Native QR Pay, and OAuth tasks to focused references.
Explains how to call CloudBase Integration Center generated HTTP cloud functions.
Covers wx.cloud.callHTTPFunction, wx.requestPayment, WeixinJSBridge, and local API wrapper patterns.
Highlights callback and order-query checks before payment fulfillment.
Troubleshoots route errors, credential setup, openid mismatch, and callback failures.
Keeps merchant keys, AppSecret values, and certificates in CloudBase console configuration.
limitations: It does not create Integration Center instances through undocumented APIs.
It requires the real CloudBase environment ID, function name, and route paths from the user.
It cannot verify live payment status without logs, callbacks, or a test transaction.
Official console screens may change, so linked CloudBase docs remain authoritative.

use_cases.title: Add Mini Program Payment
use_cases.description: Guide a Mini Program checkout through generated payment functions, requestPayment, and server-side confirmation.

use_cases.title: Implement Official Account Checkout
use_cases.description: Plan OAuth openid retrieval and JSAPI payment inside the WeChat browser.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Payment Integration Failures
use_cases.description: Trace 404 errors, missing credentials, callback failures, and openid mismatches before changing code.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Payment Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose the correct CloudBase WeChat integration flow for my app. Ask for the client type, payment type, and whether OAuth is needed.

prompt_templates.title: Wire Mini Program Pay
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through adding Mini Program WeChat Pay with CloudBase Integration Center. Include the generated function name, requestPayment step, and callback confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Build Official Account JSAPI Pay
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an Official Account JSAPI payment flow on CloudBase. Include OAuth openid retrieval, generated function calls, and order status verification.

prompt_templates.title: Extend Generated Payment Logic
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my CloudBase generated payment function extension plan. Check order persistence, idempotency, amount validation, callback handling, and secret boundaries.

output_examples.input: I need JSAPI Pay in a WeChat Official Account page.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies JSAPI Pay, requires an Official Account openid, asks for the generated function route, and confirms payment through callback or query.

output_examples.input: My Mini Program payment succeeds, but the order is not fulfilled.
output_examples.output: The skill checks whether frontend success is being trusted, then directs review of callback logs, order queries, and idempotent fulfillment logic.

output_examples.input: I need Native QR-code payment for a web checkout.
output_examples.output: The skill separates Native Pay from JSAPI Pay, plans QR rendering from code_url, and waits for callback or polling confirmation before fulfillment.

best_practices: Confirm the actual generated function name and route before writing client calls.
Use callbacks or order queries as the authoritative payment state.
Keep merchant secrets, AppSecret values, keys, and certificates in CloudBase console configuration.
anti_patterns: Do not hard-code example function names when the console generated different names.
Do not fulfill orders based only on frontend payment success callbacks.
Do not paste merchant secrets, private keys, certificates, or AppSecret values into chat or source code.

faq.question: Does this skill create CloudBase integrations automatically?
faq.answer: No. It treats Integration Center creation as a console-first workflow unless official API support is confirmed.

faq.question: Which WeChat payment types does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Mini Program Pay, Official Account JSAPI Pay, and Native QR-code Pay.

faq.question: Can it help with Official Account OAuth?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains openid retrieval, userinfo boundaries, OAuth routes, and JSAPI Pay preparation.

faq.question: Does it store or request payment secrets?
faq.answer: No. It instructs agents to keep secrets in CloudBase console configuration and out of chat or source code.

faq.question: Can it debug callback failures?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides checks for callback URLs, generated function routes, logs, credentials, and idempotent order updates.

faq.question: Does it replace official CloudBase documentation?
faq.answer: No. It routes users to official docs for console details and uses the skill references for implementation context.
